title: Cupboard doors that jam

events.text: 6 of 8 doors and drawers open fully; doorWhole_1R_hinge gets only 75% of the way, doorWhole_2L_hinge gets only 0% of the way.
One of the lower doors on the kitchen cupboard won't open, and the one next to it sticks partway.

Both doors now open fully, but I got there by switching off the cupboard's self-collision, which has a side effect.

**Cause:** The two stuck doors, `doorWhole_1R` and `doorWhole_2L`, are next to each other. Their collision boxes overlap each other or the frame, so they jam against it.
- `doorWhole_1R` stalls at 75%.
- `doorWhole_2L` stays shut.

The other six doors don't have that overlap.

**Change:** I turned self-collision off. In the joints probe, all 8 doors now reach their targets (fraction 1.0, where before it was 0.75 and −0.05).

**Trade-off:** The doors and frame can now pass through each other. That's invisible when you open and close normally. It would show up if you pushed a door into a neighbour or into the frame. I can't edit the collision boxes here, so this was the only fix available.

Please open the doors again and check that the lower pair open fully and look right. Let me know if the doors passing through each other would be a problem for how you'll use it.
Every door and drawer (8) opens fully.
